headline: Frequently Asked Questions
sub: Answers to the questions we hear most from coaches, ADs, and families.

questions.q: How much does Photo Day cost our organization?
questions.a: Nothing. Photo Day is completely free to your organization. Families pay for the packages and products they want. You provide the athletes and the space — we handle everything else.

questions.q: How long does Photo Day take?
questions.a: It depends on your roster size, but we typically photograph 20-25 athletes per hour. A team of 50 athletes usually takes 2-3 hours including setup and breakdown.

questions.q: What do athletes need to bring?
questions.a: Their uniform and any props they want (ball, helmet, etc.). We handle all the lighting, backdrops, and direction.

questions.q: Can we do both individual and team photos?
questions.a: Yes. Our standard Photo Day includes individual portraits and a team group shot. Additional poses and styles can be arranged in advance.
After the shoot, every family receives a secure link to their private online gallery. They can browse, select, and purchase directly from their phone or computer — no paper forms.

questions.q: How long until galleries are ready?
questions.a: Galleries are typically live within 1-2 weeks of your Photo Day. We'll notify you and families as soon as they're ready.
Digital downloads, prints in various sizes, and custom packages. Families can mix and match based on what they need.

questions.q: What if a family has an issue with their order?
questions.a: Contact us directly at service@phireworxphoto.com and we'll make it right. We stand behind every order.

questions.q: What's the difference between Photo Day and Media Day?
questions.a: Photo Day is a high-volume individual portrait session — great for every athlete on the roster. Media Day is a full creative production with advanced lighting, smoke effects, and dramatic setups. It's prepaid by the program and every image is delivered digitally.
Media Day is priced per athlete based on roster size. The program pays one flat rate upfront — no packages for families to navigate, no per-image fees.

questions.q: Can we do both Photo Day and Media Day?
questions.a: Yes. Many programs book a standard Photo Day for their full roster and add a Media Day shoot for their varsity or featured athletes.

questions.q: What sizes do banners come in?
questions.a: We offer banners ranging from 2x3 ft. to 4x6 ft. for individuals, and larger formats for team banners. Custom sizes available — contact us to discuss.

questions.q: How long does banner production take?
questions.a: 3-7 business days after your order is confirmed and payment received.

questions.q: Do I need to provide photos for a banner?
questions.a: Not necessarily. If you've already had a Photo Day or Media Day with us, we can pull from your existing images. If not, we can schedule a quick individual shoot.
